summary: Snapshot of an uncommitted, partial implementation that removes extension detection and routes new workspaces through manual, profile-driven extension selection. The segment enumerates what currently works, identifies seven significant gaps (e.g., manual enablement does not gate default tools or extension-host providers; revert actions can mutate canonical extension profiles; temporary overrides are a client-only convention; canonical defaults are frozen snapshots; the protocol still models detection; nested roots cannot be configured; tools/prompt modes are not honored by session creation), and proposes minimal protocol, storage, activation, and UI fixes plus a list of tests to add. Verification observed: pnpm check passed, project-catalog/extension-registry tests 12 passed, new profile-overrides tests 2 passed, app suite 157 passed, with unrelated agent-server failures and one stray blank line in registry.ts.
decisions: Remove detect/detectRoots from the extension contract and implementations; new workspaces start with no enabled integrations.
Treat all loaded extensions as globally installed (registry.ts returns every loaded extension with root "."); do not inspect workspace contents for detection.
Use `.gizmo/profiles.json` as the authoritative profile store per project; `project.profiles.save` rewrites the file atomically with full WorkspaceProfiles.
Editing a built-in/default profile creates a `workspace:temporary` derived profile, and returning values to the base removes that override.
Active session activation sends only the active profile's `integrations` and re-resolves current active integrations on thread resume rather than restoring a per-thread snapshot.
Validation on save covers only active-profile existence, known extension IDs, and roots; base references, duplicate IDs, temporary-profile invariants, and inheritance are not validated.
Svelte/Git/Activity client extensions remain statically installed in the app registry independent of the server catalog.
Recommended (proposed, not yet implemented): rename `project.detect` to an installed-extension catalog RPC, remove `detected`, make `add.integrations` optional, and bump protocolVersion.

Recommended: keep storage v1 with full profiles but add server-side normalization that rejects duplicate IDs, requires active/base IDs to resolve, allows at most one temporary override per canonical base, prunes overrides equal to their base (restoring base as active), and leaves ordinary user profiles unchanged.
Recommended: route all profile mutations (including revertTools/revertPrompt/revertToBase) through `editableProfile()` so canonical extension profiles cannot be mutated.
Recommended: reuse an existing temporary override for a canonical base instead of creating multiple override files.
Recommended: add a root input/folder chooser for enabled extensions to support monorepo nested roots.
Recommended: keep historical tool-result renderers loaded globally so old transcripts remain readable when an extension is disabled.

Recommended: gate extension-host providers, CompositeProjectService providers, project-specific web contributions, defaultTools, and prompt fragments by the active profile, with tools.mode and prompt.mode actually affecting session construction.
Recommended: either exclude non-activatable/global-only packages from profile checkbox lists or gate their behavior by the active profile.
